Local measurements work immediately. Add your own AI provider when you want a conversation about them.

Set up your AI in three steps

  1. Create an API account with your chosen provider. A chat subscription alone does not supply an API key.
  2. Enter its model ID and API key below, save the profile, then choose Use this engineer.
  3. For speaking and listening, save an OpenAI voice key and choose your transcription service. In Mixing, press Speak and optionally enable Voice replies.

Get an API key: OpenAI · Anthropic · Gemini

OPTIONAL

Scrunch does not include an AI subscription. Requests use your provider account and may cost money. Saving a model profile does not send a question.

Voice

OFF UNTIL YOU ASK

Turn on Voice replies in Mixing when you want spoken answers. The microphone starts only when you press Speak. This preview uses cloud transcription; no local speech helper is bundled.

Voice configuration and conversation on a new Mac still need real-world testing. Voice key saving checks its format and stores it in Keychain.

Local MIDI tools

These checks show whether the local models are installed. They do not certify transcription accuracy.

Check the installed tools before your first transcription.

Ready for a first check

Choose a bounce in Mixing, explore a timestamp, then compare another version. Audio and up to ten measurement reports stay in memory and disappear when you clear them or quit.

Live capture and corrections need the Scrunch Bridge installed in Ableton. This preview does not certify Live 12.4.5 or M4 operation. Opening Mixing and closing it while idle leave Ableton alone.
